opening_question_spark: If food is everywhere, how can eating the same few things still fail you?
entry_transition: The real question is what those repeated meals provide.
cta: What would you add to this island diet?
body: But health also needs vitamins, minerals, protein, and fats.
Eating only a few foods can leave gaps.
Those gaps can cause health problems over time.
Fresh plants may add nutrients repeated meals miss.
Clean drinking water is essential every day.
Shelter protects you from heat, rain, and storms.
Injuries or infections can become dangerous without medical care.
And even perfect nutrition cannot stop normal aging.
optional_closing: Plenty of food helps, but it cannot make you live forever.
full_narration: If food is everywhere, how can eating the same few things still fail you? The real question is what those repeated meals provide. Calories give your body energy. But health also needs vitamins, minerals, protein, and fats. Eating only a few foods can leave gaps. Those gaps can cause health problems over time. Fresh plants may add nutrients repeated meals miss. Clean drinking water is essential every day. Shelter protects you from heat, rain, and storms. Injuries or infections can become dangerous without medical care. And even perfect nutrition cannot stop normal aging. Plenty of food helps, but it cannot make you live forever.
